soundness.checkable_by: Specify the objects, domains, allowed operations, exact conclusion, boundary conditions and faithful interpretation; provide a complete proof or reproducible test. The file's main statement is a definition/stipulation and a semantic replacement rule for Λ in the Friedmann equations, not a derivable mathematical proposition. It also gives several alternative forms (general factorized form, multiple f and g choices, canonical tanh form) without a single precise theorem to prove. Encoding the defining equation as a conclusion with no premises would be tautological, while encoding it as a premise would violate the rule against assuming the conclusion.

obstructions.reason: The derivation fails at the step from analogical creaturely participation in God to a specific consciousness-dependent replacement for Λ in the Friedmann equations; P-IMAGO expressly excludes that physical/mathematical inference.
